title: Twin attacks on IP members in Maguindanao del Sur condemned

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Institutions in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) have condemned the successive shooting incidents in Maguindanao del Sur that claimed the lives of two Non-Moro Indigenous Peoples (IP) and wounded another. The BARMM Ministry of Indigenous Peoples Affairs (MIPA) slammed the attacks and raised concern over it while calling for justice for the victims. “These acts of violence are deeply alarming and raise serious concerns about the safety and security of IP communities in the BARMM,” MIPA Minister Guiamal Abdulrahman said in a statement on Tuesday.
